description: Source code for the 'Page' class and related components in Playwright, handling browser page interactions, events, and scripting.

classes.name: Page
classes.description: Represents a browser page, managing navigation, events, scripts, and interactions.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: Represents a web worker associated with a page.

classes.name: PageBinding
classes.description: Handles exposing functions to the page context.

classes.name: InitScript
classes.description: Represents a script to be injected into the page or context.

methods.name: reportAsNew
methods.description: Marks the page as initialized, optionally with an error.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Resets the page state for reuse.

methods.name: _didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the page is closed.

methods.name: _didCrash
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the page crashes.

methods.name: opener
methods.description: Returns the page that opened this page, if any.

methods.name: mainFrame
methods.description: Returns the main frame of the page.

methods.name: frames
methods.description: Returns all frames of the page.

methods.name: exposeBinding
methods.description: Exposes a function to the page context.

methods.name: setExtraHTTPHeaders
methods.description: Sets extra HTTP headers for the page.

methods.name: onBindingCalled
methods.description: Handles a call from a page binding.

methods.name: performActionPreChecks
methods.description: Performs pre-action checks like navigation and locator handling.

methods.name: setEmulatedSizeFromWindowOpen
methods.description: Sets emulated size based on window open.

methods.name: needsRequestInterception
methods.description: Checks if request interception is needed.

methods.name: isClosedOrClosingOrCrashed
methods.description: Checks if page is closed, closing, or crashed.

methods.name: fileChooserIntercepted
methods.description: Checks if file chooser is intercepted.

methods.name: safeNonStallingEvaluateInAllFrames
methods.description: Evaluates expression in all frames safely.

methods.name: snapshotForAI
methods.description: Takes a snapshot for AI processing.
